newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Germany's DBBH closes offer for Hungary bank shrs.
newsitem.headline: Germany's DBBH closes offer for Hungary bank shrs.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Balaton Broker Holding AG (DBBH) on Friday closed its offer for the series "C" preference shares of Hungarian bank Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank Rt (MKB).

DBBH, which released a statement via its wholly owned Hungarian broker subsidiary Elso Magyarorszagi Nemet Ertekpapirkereskedelmi Kft, declined to release how many shares it had bought during the offer which opened on May 5 and was extended until May 30 with unchanged conditions on May 16.
The original offer was made at 35,000 forint per share for the series "C" stocks of MKB, a bank majority owned by Germany's Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale.
Hungarian brokerages publish bids for MKB's series "C" shares at 147 and 148 percent of the face value or 14,700 to 14,800 forints, in Hungarian economic newspapers.
